name: Edelteq Holdings Berhad
overview: Edelteq 今年完成对 Nixma Technology (M) Sdn. Bhd. 51% 股权的投资（总代价 RM15,300,000），并完成收购一栋四层半独立式轻工业单位。公司亦进行免费凭单发行及多项新股发行活动。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比增 209.2% 至 RM286,148,000，净利润同比增 42.7% 至 RM4,619,000。
overview_en: Edelteq completed the investment of a 51% equity interest in Nixma Technology (M) Sdn. Bhd. for a total consideration of RM15,300,000, and completed the acquisition of a unit of four-storey semi-detached light industrial unit. The company also carried out a bonus issue of free warrants and several new issue of securities exercises. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue rose 209.2% YoY to RM286,148,000, with net profit up 42.7% YoY to RM4,619,000.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 完成对 Nixma Technology 的 51% 股权投资，并完成收购一栋四层半独立式轻工业单位。
segments.note_en: Completed the 51% equity investment in Nixma Technology and the acquisition of a unit of four-storey semi-detached light industrial unit.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Nixma 认购股份已配发及发行予 Edelteq，销售股份已于 2026 年 11 月 6 日转让，投资完成。
actions.text_en: The subscription shares were allotted and issued to Edelteq and the sale shares were transferred on 6 November 2026, completing the investment.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: Nixma 投资的条件先决条件于 2026 年 10 月 30 日达成，相关协议转为无条件。
actions.text_en: The conditions precedent for the Nixma investment were fulfilled on 30 October 2026 and the agreements became unconditional.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 300,000 投资 Nixma Technology (M) Sdn. Bhd. 51% 股权，包括收购 45,000 股现有股份（RM4,500,000）及认购 108,000 股新股。
actions.text_en: Proposed investment of a 51% equity interest in Nixma Technology (M) Sdn. Bhd. for a total consideration of RM15,300,000, comprising acquisition of 45,000 existing shares (RM4,500,000) and subscription of 108,000 new shares.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Edelteq Technologies Sdn. Bhd. 完成收购一栋四层半独立式轻工业单位。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Edelteq Technologies Sdn. Bhd. completed the acquisition of a unit of four-storey semi-detached light industrial unit.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过投资 Nixma Technology 51% 股权，将 Nixma 纳入集团业务。
model_changes.text_en: Through the 51% equity investment in Nixma Technology, Nixma becomes part of the group.
